tools.name: select_move
tools.description: Select one candidate handle visible in this decision and finish the decision. Cite only issued evidence IDs. Use an empty evidence_ids array when none is cited and an empty brief_note when no note is needed. This tool does not commit a game turn.

tools.name: compare_moves
tools.description: Request a bounded comparison of two to four distinct candidate handles visible in this decision. Choose a currently available tier. The host checks handles, tier, phase, and remaining resources before execution. The result is an estimate and does not finish the decision.
